name: Dosukebe Ura Soap-jou ~JK Hen~ play.9 Kachiku Inkei Kiriotoshi THE NOVEL
original_name: ドスケベ裏ソープ嬢～JK編～ play.9 家畜陰茎切り落とし THE NOVEL
source:
After you signed the contract to become livestock in your own urine,
you no longer have a need for a penis, so she cuts it off.
Your days as a human and as a man are over.
